summary: Skyworks Solutions filed an 8-K on July 28, 2026, reporting Q3 FY2026 results and announcing its board authorized a $2.0 billion stock repurchase program through January 31, 2029, succeeding and terminating the prior $2.0 billion program from February 2025. Separately, the board decided not to declare any quarterly cash dividends going forward. Repurchases may occur on the open market or privately, funded by working capital; timing and amount are at management's discretion, and the program may be suspended anytime. Watch for execution pace and potential EPS support versus reduced income appeal.
